description: This file manages the Discord provider integration for the openclaw project, including startup, command deployment, gateway lifecycle, and runtime configuration. It contains functions for monitoring Discord, handling commands, and managing voice and gateway components.

methods.name: loadDiscordVoiceRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the Discord voice runtime module, with support for testing overrides.

methods.name: loadDiscordProviderSessionRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the Discord provider session runtime module, with support for testing overrides.

methods.name: normalizeBooleanForTesting
methods.description: Converts a value to a boolean or undefined, used in testing scenarios.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingsEnabledForTesting
methods.description: Resolves whether thread bindings are enabled, with testing support.

methods.name: formatThreadBindingDurationForConfigLabel
methods.description: Formats a duration in ms into a label string, with special handling for 'disabled'.

methods.name: appendPluginCommandSpecs
methods.description: Merges plugin command specifications into existing command list, avoiding duplicates and logging conflicts.

methods.name: isLegacyMissingSessionError
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a legacy missing session error.

methods.name: classifyAcpStatusProbeError
methods.description: Classifies an error during ACP status probing into 'stale' or 'uncertain' with reasons.

methods.name: probeDiscordAcpBindingHealth
methods.description: Probes the health of a Discord ACP binding, with timeout and error classification.

methods.name: deployDiscordCommands
methods.description: Deploys native Discord commands with retries, rate limit handling, and error logging.

methods.name: formatDiscordStartupGatewayState
methods.description: Formats the state of the Discord gateway for logging.

methods.name: logDiscordStartupPhase
methods.description: Logs a phase of Discord startup with timing and optional gateway info.

methods.name: attachDiscordDeployRequestBody
methods.description: Attaches the request body to a Discord deployment error object for debugging.

methods.name: stringifyDiscordDeployField
methods.description: Converts a value to a string for deployment error reporting.

methods.name: readDiscordDeployRejectedFields
methods.description: Reads rejected fields from a deployment error payload.

methods.name: resolveDiscordRejectedDeployEntriesSource
methods.description: Extracts the source of rejected deployment entries from raw error body.

methods.name: formatDiscordRejectedDeployEntries
methods.description: Formats a list of rejected deployment entries for reporting.

methods.name: formatDiscordDeployErrorDetails
methods.description: Generates a detailed string of error info for deployment errors.

methods.name: isDiscordDisallowedIntentsError
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates Discord disallowed intents.

methods.name: monitorDiscordProvider
methods.description: Main function to monitor and manage a Discord provider instance, including startup, command deployment, gateway lifecycle, and runtime configuration.
